units.source_text: 昨夜秘密来此，无人知道；

en.t: Last night he came here in secret, and no one knew.

units.source_text: 今日消息已经公开，故王侯公卿都来接待，全体护送这位准太上天皇返六条院。

en.t: Today the news had become public, so princes, nobles, and high courtiers all came to receive him, and together they escorted this quasi Retired Emperor back to Rokujo-in.
Genji thought of his own children.

units.source_text: 明石女御自幼疼爱无比，现在高居尊位；

en.t: The Akashi Consort, whom he had loved beyond measure since childhood, now occupied an exalted rank.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将也身显名扬，出人头地。

en.t: General Yugiri too had risen in status, won renown, and distinguished himself above others.
Everything had turned out just as he wished.

units.source_text: 然而对冷泉院，感情尤为深挚，心中念念不忘。

en.t: Yet his feelings for Reizei-in were especially deep, and he never ceased thinking of him.

units.source_text: 冷泉院也时时记挂他，在位时常恨会面机会稀少，

en.t: Reizei-in also kept him constantly in mind, and while on the throne he often regretted how few chances they had to meet.

units.source_text: 因此早年让位，以便自由行动。

en.t: For that reason he abdicated early, so that he could move about more freely.

units.source_text: 然而秋好皇后反而难得归宁了，

en.t: However, Empress Akikonomu in turn found it difficult to return to her family home.

units.source_text: 她和冷泉院像普通臣下一般同居共乐，

en.t: She and Reizei-in lived together and enjoyed each other's company like ordinary subjects.

units.source_text: 游宴之事、管弦之会反比在位时兴浓。

en.t: Their pleasure outings and gatherings for pipes and strings were even more spirited than during his reign.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后万事心满意足，

en.t: Empress Akikonomu was satisfied in every respect.

units.source_text: 惟有想起亡母六条妃子在阴司受苦，出家学佛之志日益坚强起来。

en.t: Only when she thought of her late mother, Lady Rokujo, suffering in the underworld did her resolve to take religious vows and study the Buddha's way grow stronger day by day.

units.source_text: 但源氏和冷泉院皆不允许，她只得多多为亡母举办功德。

en.t: But Genji and Reizei-in both refused to permit it, so she could only sponsor many meritorious rites for her late mother.

units.source_text: 虽不出家，而人世无常之念日益深切。

en.t: Although she did not become a nun, her sense of the impermanence of human life deepened day by day.

units.source_text: 源氏也和秋好皇后同心，立即准备为六条妃子举办法华八讲。

en.t: Genji shared Empress Akikonomu's feelings and immediately began preparing to hold the Eight Lectures on the Lotus Sutra for Lady Rokujo.
